claimBoundary: Model results and operational diagnostics are loaded from the verified remote evaluation and integrity manifests bound to the recorded source revision.

dataQuality.capacityPolicy: Station capacity is descriptive, not a clipping ceiling; observed counts can exceed it.
dataQuality.ingestionTimestampLimitation: The supplied files contain event timestamps but no ingestion timestamps, so local evaluation assumes rows at or before the origin were available then.
dataQuality.mappingPolicy: Stable coordinate-derived sensor IDs; each station maps to its nearest sensor; distance remains a model feature and a diagnostic.

governance: Aggregate operational decision support—not a safety controller or an individual employee decision system.
Managed identities and Key Vault keep credentials out of code and logs.
Human approval is required for model promotion; one holdout cannot auto-promote a champion.
Privacy and AI-risk classification must be revisited if individual mobility, worker decisions, or safety-critical automation enter scope.

failureModes.action: Block publication; retain last successful batch
Fail closed to declared fallback; alert owner

operations.fallback: Seven-day seasonal naive, then cutoff-safe station × weekday × hour median
operations.publishPolicy: Publish atomically only after all 420 records pass schema, finiteness, and completeness checks.

tabpfn.host: 8 CPU cores · 15 GiB RAM · no GPU
tabpfn.laterGate: Approved GPU or explicit egress approval; pinned v2 weights; telemetry disabled; 4,096-step context; identical rolling-origin protocol.
reasons: Direct v2 evidence centered on datasets up to 10,000 rows.
The configured host does not meet the preferred GPU execution path.
TabPFN-TS drops the static and past-only covariates this use case depends on.
